name: render
description: Render hosting: post-merge deploy-live and log checks, release checks for services and env groups, and runtime-fit rules for memory-bound work.

facts.name: DEPLOY_SERVICES
facts.meaning: A markdown table: code area (path glob) -> Render service name(s). Shared code lists every service built from it.
facts.ask: Which Render service runs which code? The installer lists the services from render.yaml; for each code area, name the service(s) that build it, and mark shared code that several services build.

facts.name: ENV_GROUPS
facts.meaning: Each Render env group and the services that must link it.
facts.ask: Which Render env groups exist, and which services must link each one? (none if the project sets variables per service)

facts.name: RUNTIME_MEMORY_LIMIT
facts.meaning: Memory ceiling of the smallest instance that runs app code.
facts.ask: What is the memory limit of the smallest Render instance that runs your code (for example 512 MB on a starter plan)?

env.name: RENDER_API_KEY
env.purpose: Lets the Render MCP server read services, deploys, logs and metrics.
env.how_to_get: Owner task: Render dashboard > Account Settings > API Keys > Create API Key. The key reaches every workspace the account can see; keep it in your shell environment or secret manager, never in a committed file.
